established_contexts: Frozen paved-road right-turn cell by a freight-loading zone. The business-district and other-area signal-distance branches are constructed separately; actual site classification and Native visibility need independent source review.

variable_parameters.name: indicator_start_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: nonnegative engineering metres before turn onset

variable_parameters.name: district_type
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: business, residential or other; legal classification pending exact site evidence

variable_parameters.name: indicator_interruption_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: optional closed interval of remaining approach metres

variable_parameters.name: measured_continuous_distance_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: nonnegative source-measured metres before turn onset

variable_parameters.name: precipitation
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: CARLA precipitation scale; does not change statutory threshold

variable_parameters.name: freight_zone
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored freight-loading-zone sign and bay; exact visibility pending source review
